sleep.text_english: Aim for 7-8 hours of sleep each night, keeping a consistent bedtime and wake-up time.

exercise.text_english: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate physical activity on 5 or more days a week.

water.text_english: Drink 2-3 litres of water spread across the day.

diet.text_english: Include more fruits, vegetables and whole grains in your daily meals.

stress.text_english: Practise meditation or deep breathing for a few minutes each day to help manage stress.
